5
1Frɛ ɛ, obi wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛbua woɔ?
Na akronkronfoɔ mu hwan na wode bɛdan no?
2Na ahisɛm kum agyimifoɔ,
na ninkuntwe kum atetekwaa.
3 # Dwom 37.35-36 Me deɛ, mahunu ogyimifoɔ a ɔgyee nhini,
nanso amonom hɔ ara na medomee ne tenabea;
4ne mma ne nkwagyeɛ ntam twe,
na wɔpɛkyɛ wɔn
wɔ kuro pono mu a ɔgyefoɔ nni hɔ.
5Wɔn a wɔdi kɔm bɛdi ne nnɔbaeɛ,
na nsɔeɛ mu mpo na wɔbɛfa,
na adufudepɛfoɔ amene wɔn adedodoɔ.
6Ɛfiri sɛ mmusuo mfifiri mfiri mfuturo mu,
na ɔhaw nso mfu mfiri fam.
7Na wɔwoo onipa maa ɔhaw,
sɛ ogyaframa tutu kɔ soro no.
8Na me a, anka mɛhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn akyiri kwan,
na mede m’asɛm mahyɛ ne nsa,
9 # Hiob 9.10 deɛ ɔyɛ ade kɛseɛ a ɛnni nhwehwɛmu,
anwanwadeɛ nso a wɔntumi nkan.
10Deɛ ɔma osuo tɔ asase soɔ,
na ɔma nsuo ba wira mu,
11 # Dwom 75.7; Luk 1.52 ɔde ahobrɛasefoɔ tena deɛ ɛkorɔn,
na ɔma abooboodifoɔ so kɔ yiedie mu.
12Ɔsɛe anitefoɔ atirimpɔ,
na wɔn nsa antumi anyɛ adepa biara.
13 # 1 Ko 3.19 Ɔkyere anyansafoɔ wɔn aniteɛ mu,
na ɔbutu akontonkyifoɔ agyina.
14 # Yes 59.9-10 Wɔtɔ sum mu awia,
na awia ketee wɔkeka sɛ anadwo.
15Na ɔgye ohiani firi afena a ɛfiri wɔn anomu no ano,
ne ɔhoɔdenfoɔ nsam.
16Na mmɔborɔni nya anidasoɔ,
na amumuyɛ mua n’ano.
17 # Mmb 3.11; Dwom 94.12 Hwɛ, nhyira ne ɔdasani a Onyankopɔn ka n’anim,
enti, mpo Otumfoɔ atenetene no.
18 # Deut 32.39; Hos 6.1 Na ɔno na ɔpira, na ɔkyekyere soɔ,
ɔpɛkyɛ, na ne nsa nso sa.
19 # Mmb 24.16 Ɔbɛyi wo afiri ahohiahia nsia mu,
aane, na deɛ ɛtɔ so nson no mu, bɔne renka wo.
20Ɛkɔm berɛ ɔbɛgye wo afiri owuo mu,
na akodie mu nso wagye wo afiri afena ano.
21Ɔbɛkora wo afiri tɛkyerɛma mpire ano,
na wɔrensuro sɛeɛ a ɛbɛba.
22Wobɛsere sɛeɛ ne ɛkɔm,
na asase so mmoadoma nso, worensuro wɔn.
23 # Hos 2.18; Yes 11.6-9 Ɛfiri sɛ wo ne wiram aboɔ mpo bɛyɛ apam,
na wiram mmoadoma bɛdwo ama wo.
24Na wobɛhunu sɛ wo ntomadan si hɔ dwoodwoo,
na wohwɛ wo tenabea a, worenhunu sɛ atɔ mu.
25Na wobɛhunu nso sɛ w’asefoɔ bɛdɔɔso pii,
na wɔn a wɔfiri wo mu bɛyɛ sɛ asase so nhahan,
26wode onyinkyerɛ na ɛbɛkɔ damena mu,
sɛ wɔde ayuo afiafi ba mu ne berɛ mu no.
27Hwɛ, yei na yɛahwehwɛ ahunu, sɛ ɛteɛ nie;
tie, na wo nso, hunu fa!

pageProps.chapterText:
Frɛ ɛ, obi wɔ hɔ a ɔbɛbua woɔ?
Na akronkronfoɔ mu hwan na wode bɛdan no?
Na ahisɛm kum agyimifoɔ,
na ninkuntwe kum atetekwaa.
Me deɛ, mahunu ogyimifoɔ a ɔgyee nhini,
nanso amonom hɔ ara na medomee ne tenabea;
ne mma ne nkwagyeɛ ntam twe,
na wɔpɛkyɛ wɔn
wɔ kuro pono mu a ɔgyefoɔ nni hɔ.
Wɔn a wɔdi kɔm bɛdi ne nnɔbaeɛ,
na nsɔeɛ mu mpo na wɔbɛfa,
na adufudepɛfoɔ amene wɔn adedodoɔ.
Ɛfiri sɛ mmusuo mfifiri mfiri mfuturo mu,
na ɔhaw nso mfu mfiri fam.
Na wɔwoo onipa maa ɔhaw,
sɛ ogyaframa tutu kɔ soro no.

Na me a, anka mɛhwehwɛ Nyankopɔn akyiri kwan,
na mede m’asɛm mahyɛ ne nsa,
deɛ ɔyɛ ade kɛseɛ a ɛnni nhwehwɛmu,
anwanwadeɛ nso a wɔntumi nkan.
Deɛ ɔma osuo tɔ asase soɔ,
na ɔma nsuo ba wira mu,
ɔde ahobrɛasefoɔ tena deɛ ɛkorɔn,
na ɔma abooboodifoɔ so kɔ yiedie mu.
Ɔsɛe anitefoɔ atirimpɔ,
na wɔn nsa antumi anyɛ adepa biara.
Ɔkyere anyansafoɔ wɔn aniteɛ mu,
na ɔbutu akontonkyifoɔ agyina.
Wɔtɔ sum mu awia,
na awia ketee wɔkeka sɛ anadwo.
Na ɔgye ohiani firi afena a ɛfiri wɔn anomu no ano,
ne ɔhoɔdenfoɔ nsam.
Na mmɔborɔni nya anidasoɔ,
na amumuyɛ mua n’ano.

Hwɛ, nhyira ne ɔdasani a Onyankopɔn ka n’anim,
enti, mpo Otumfoɔ atenetene no.
Na ɔno na ɔpira, na ɔkyekyere soɔ,
ɔpɛkyɛ, na ne nsa nso sa.
Ɔbɛyi wo afiri ahohiahia nsia mu,
aane, na deɛ ɛtɔ so nson no mu, bɔne renka wo.
Ɛkɔm berɛ ɔbɛgye wo afiri owuo mu,
na akodie mu nso wagye wo afiri afena ano.
Ɔbɛkora wo afiri tɛkyerɛma mpire ano,
na wɔrensuro sɛeɛ a ɛbɛba.
Wobɛsere sɛeɛ ne ɛkɔm,
na asase so mmoadoma nso, worensuro wɔn.
Ɛfiri sɛ wo ne wiram aboɔ mpo bɛyɛ apam,
na wiram mmoadoma bɛdwo ama wo.
Na wobɛhunu sɛ wo ntomadan si hɔ dwoodwoo,
na wohwɛ wo tenabea a, worenhunu sɛ atɔ mu.
Na wobɛhunu nso sɛ w’asefoɔ bɛdɔɔso pii,
na wɔn a wɔfiri wo mu bɛyɛ sɛ asase so nhahan,
wode onyinkyerɛ na ɛbɛkɔ damena mu,
sɛ wɔde ayuo afiafi ba mu ne berɛ mu no.
Hwɛ, yei na yɛahwehwɛ ahunu, sɛ ɛteɛ nie;
tie, na wo nso, hunu fa!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
